summary: Show every image in a conversation in the terminal UI: a message's images, a Discord import's, a tool result's and an ask's load inline where the terminal draws them, with their real type and size before they load and an unreachable owner said on the image's line. Asks can carry images (st work ask --attach).

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection migration. An ask claim's request gains an optional attachments list inside its existing request object; transcript image references gain a size and a sniffed type when they are read.

schema.detail: No database schema or index change. The client schema's StructuredRequest gains an optional attachments array of the existing Attachment shape.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digest inputs are unchanged. An ask's images must be the asker's own held uploads, as a message's must; a blob read may name an ask's person step as its carrier, which the person it asks, or anyone in free mode when an agent asks, may read.

compatibility.detail: A member on an older build refuses to read an ask whose request carries images (unknown field), as it refuses any request from a newer build, and an older terminal UI or phone shows such an ask without its images. Upgrade every member before agents ask with --attach.

manual.detail: Nothing to do. ST3_DOWNLOADS, when set, chooses where the terminal UI saves an image it cannot show with a viewer; otherwise the XDG download directory or ~/Downloads.

recovery.detail: Rolling back is safe until an ask carries images; after that an older daemon refuses those asks, so roll forward or cancel them first.

downtime.detail: A normal daemon restart and a new terminal UI; nothing waits on a migration.
